summary: The trace revealed a critical ZIP lifecycle bug: closing the input ZIP before reading all pass-through binary data, causing ValueError. The existing pptx-xml-editing skill warns against read/write same file but doesn't cover the 'read all data first, then close, then write' pattern. This patch adds a safe ZIP workflow template, a reusable helper script for the read-modify-write pattern, and explicit anti-pattern guidance to prevent this failure mode.
